messages:
marta: Quick notes from noon POC kickoff with Meridian — they're planning a competitor-swap from CompY. Top asks: token billing predictability for 90d POC, identical request/response shape, and a clear security binding for logs. Posting owners.

ev an: Tech summary: their SDK posts `content` + `meta.flags` and expects `stop_sequences` semantics. We'll map `meta.flags.trace_id` -> x-request-id header and convert stop_sequences -> stop tokens. I'll sketch adapter.

samir: Token delta: CompY trims trailing whitespace and collapses multiple newlines before counting. Proposal: two options for POC: (1) adapter applies same normalization so counts match, or (2) fixed POC rate with reconciliation. Which does sales prefer?

claire: Buyer prefers option 1 to keep billing identical during trial. Also asking for a sample diff report before next call.

sec-bot: sec-bot: questionnaire uploaded -> /meridian_poc/security_q1.pdf :white_check_mark:

marta: Security asks: SOC2 report, customer KMS for Dedicated, IP allowlist for control plane, SAML SCIM. Also need deletion API and audit receipt for any log purge. @samir can we provide deletion receipt?

samir: Yes 14 our logs API supports DELETE /v1/logs/{session} which returns a signed deletion_receipt_id and timestamp. For Dedicated we can scope retention per-tenant.

ev an: Streaming parity: CompY streams many tiny deltas; add `stream_chunk_hint=small` and `nodelay=true` in adapter. Also note quantized variants change tokenization on punctuation-heavy prompts.

claire: Pricing Q from buyer: "Can Redwood bill at a flat $Y/1k tokens for the POC?" They want zero surprises.

marta: Sales propose: adapter normalization + an upfront POC credit of $Z and a reconciliation clause if delta >5% across trial. Legal to draft clause.

samir: I'll produce a 200-prompt diff harness (side-by-side responses + token counts) and attach results. ETA tomorrow morning.

claire: Good. Schedule follow-up Wed 9am PT to review harness and security answers. Marta will draft outbound mail after Samir's report attached.

marta: Thanks team 10 will loop in legal and solutions eng.
